claims.title: A material-linked optical gain hypothesis requires measured field response and complete-device losses

status: Source-reported derivation and synthetic computations; selected same-implementation checks rerun at intake, no external proof/physical validation.
interface: Conditional optically maintained CdS-alizarin recombination hypothesis, distinct from N767 chemical-fuel chemomotor. Published inverted recombination and kinetic components are material footholds; field derivatives, actual terminal dipole/orientation, proposed-host kinetics and complete-device negative real admittance remain unmeasured. No new observed power source, prototype, efficiency/noise/lifetime advantage or readiness promotion.
limits: Measure specimen-specific formation and recombination field derivatives after charge formation, dipole-orientation lifetime, kinetics in the actual host and complete illuminated dielectric/carrier/contact losses. Require a confidence upper bound ReY_complete<0 under constant pump and zeroDC; retain device losses and all controls. Then independently verify RF power flow/passive stored-energy growth and full optical/electrical/thermal accounting before prototype or scaling claims.
